title: I'm building a tower defense game called Skyfall Keep
author: Xtrasauc3
selftext:
Hey y'all. I built Skyfall Keep. It's my take on a new tower defense game. I was always a really big fan of Bloons TD, and that's where a lot of my inspiration came from. It's completely free and runs in the browser, and I'm considering mobile for later.

Right now there are ten towers, each with three upgrade paths, two heroes, nine maps across four tiers, six game modes, and a 100 round siege at the end.

I used Claude Code, AI-generated art through Codex, Meshy for some of the enemies, and CC0 audio.

[https://skyfallkeep.com](https://skyfallkeep.com) (best on desktop for now). Give it a try and let me know what you think!
